project_info.color_palette: Sky blue, sandy beige, off-white textured paper, soft seafoam green

main_subject.detail: A centered scallop-edged rectangular paper card with a tactile cotton-paper texture placed over a softly blurred beach background. The card features a blue palm tree icon at the top, thin horizontal divider lines, the word 'VACATION' in slim uppercase blue type, and the bold headline 'MOOD-ON' in large bright blue uppercase typography.
main_subject.style: Minimal resort poster, clean branding graphic, tactile paper cutout aesthetic, soft luxury summer mood

prompt_instructions: Attach the original image as the primary reference to preserve the exact composition, paper-card proportions, and typography hierarchy.
Keep the visible text exactly as 'VACATION' and 'MOOD-ON' with the same line breaks and uppercase treatment.
Maintain the minimal layout with large negative space and a calm beach-luxury feeling rather than adding extra objects or text.
Preserve the scalloped stamp-like edges and tactile off-white paper texture because they define the visual identity of the design.
Use a softly blurred beach background so the centered graphic card remains the focal point.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square seasonal social poster for a summer vacation mood campaign. Create a softly blurred beach background with pale sandy foreground, muted aqua horizon, and gentle natural daylight. In the center, place a large off-white rectangular paper card with tactile cotton-like texture, subtle shadow, and scalloped stamp-style edges on all sides. At the top center of the card, add a simple flat blue palm tree icon. Below it, place a thin horizontal blue divider line, then the word 'VACATION' in slim uppercase blue typography. Under that, place the large bold uppercase headline 'MOOD-ON' in bright blue, followed by another thin blue divider line. At the bottom right of the card, add a small hand-drawn cluster of blue wave lines. In the bottom-left corner of the overall frame, allow a small tropical green leaf cluster to enter the scene. Style should feel minimal, premium, airy, resort-inspired, and clean. Technical style: photorealistic beach background with minimalist graphic poster overlay, soft natural daylight, airy beach haze, subtle shadow, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
